summary: This semester-synthesis lecture is a canon-candidate source because it braids Iran war, eschatological stored history, secret coordination, money as cave-alchemy, and AI-as-god into one predictive-history framework while preserving Jiang's closing demand that the framework be attacked and revised.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use this source as a late synthesis layer for eschatology as stored geopolitical memory: the Levant becomes the compressed memory field, scripture carries return across exile, failed messiahs generate Antichrist logic, and Middle East war becomes attractive when actors read temple, Gog and Magog, Antichrist, Messiah, and Jesus-return roles as operational sequence.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Eschatology owns role-script, sacred sequence, and portable historical memory. Strategy owns material chokepoints and war capacity; Game Theory owns the player/payoff method; Secret Society owns hidden coordination when secrecy and trust are the active mechanism.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Extend the end-time coordination line with Jiang's explicit claim that secret societies use occult knowledge, agents, puppets, scapegoats, secrecy, trust, and eschatological scripts to ride historical waves rather than simply command history from above.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Secret Society should not absorb the whole lecture. It owns the coordination technology; Eschatology owns the sacred script; Attention Capture owns consciousness capture; Power As Alchemy owns money and AI as value-transforming apparatuses.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Treat this as a late capstone for money-alchemy: power directs consciousness, banks turn lead into gold by making people believe debt-signs are real, money becomes godlike through social omnipresence, and crashes or wars renew scarcity when too much money has been created.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Power As Alchemy owns the conversion of belief, debt, scarcity, and monetary signs into reality. Attention Capture owns the underlying attention-energy contest when the question is focus; Strategy owns war and chokepoint material tests.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Add this source to the dollar-AI consciousness-war line: Jiang demystifies AI as backpropagation, then says its political ambition is omniscient database merger, religious animation, brain-chip obedience, and a transition from money-god to AI-god as the stronger apparatus for capturing energy, imagination, consciousness, and attention.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Attention Capture owns AI as consciousness and attention control. Mass Society owns database merger, chips, IDs, health, school, police, and work records when population administration is primary; Eschatology owns the machine made religious.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold the opening Iran sequence for the Strategy child: attacking Iran is framed as breaking a Russia-Iran-China axis, forcing Treasury demand through energy disruption and chokepoint leverage, and exporting imperial civil-war pressure outward.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Imperial Retrenchment owns debt-defense, conflict export, and exhausted empire. Chokepoint Empire owns Strait/Hormuz access-control architecture; Power As Alchemy owns Treasury demand and monetary reality.

new_lens_seeds.title: AI God As Religious Control Machine
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: AI becomes sovereign only when database omniscience is animated by religious imagination: people must believe the machine is alive, inhabited, divine, demonic, or salvific before automated direction can become obedience that feels like happiness.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The mechanism recurs across the dollar-AI, Holy Empire, and final-exam AI sources, but it currently straddles Attention Capture, Mass Society, Eschatology, and Power As Alchemy. It should be reviewed as a possible child concept rather than appended wholesale to any one page.

new_lens_seeds.title: Eschatology As Stored Geopolitical Memory
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: Long historical conflict can survive as portable sacred story when policy analysis cannot; scripture, exile, return, messianic failure, and Antichrist logic preserve geopolitical memory as roles people can re-enter.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: This is a strong formulation, but the existing Eschatology As Script page already holds the broader mechanism. Use it first as a deepening layer unless split review shows that stored-memory deserves its own child page.

atlas_mutations.current_structure: AI pressure is distributed across Attention Capture, Mass Society, Eschatology, and Power As Alchemy, while recent split/close work has focused on Strategy and Game Theory.
atlas_mutations.proposed_mutation: Do not mutate the atlas in this PR, but schedule a cross-page review of AI-as-god / AI-as-redundancy / AI-as-population-administration before adding ordinary AI sections to any one public concept page.
atlas_mutations.reason: This source makes the boundary problem explicit: AI is simultaneously a database state, religious object, attention apparatus, and successor to money-alchemy. A public mutation should decide whether this remains a routed cluster or becomes a child page.

chronology_notes.note: This source is dated 2026-05-26 and functions as the penultimate classroom synthesis before the 2026-05-28 final examination lecture: Jiang first states the predictive-history framework whole, then asks students in the next class to attack it.
The lecture is a late May 2026 consolidation of the Iran-war cluster: Jiang explicitly combines geopolitical, eschatological, and imperial-decline explanations rather than choosing only one.

The lecture gives a dated May 2026 transition claim from money-era alchemy to AI-era alchemy: monetary elites weaken through credibility crisis, and AI appears as the next contender for directing consciousness.

canon_candidates.candidate: Predictive history becomes a framework when geopolitics, eschatology, imperial decline, money, and AI are treated as different languages for one testable pattern of power: stories and material systems direct consciousness, and the framework must be attacked where prediction or observation breaks.
canon_candidates.promotion_note: Candidate only; compare against the 2026-05-28 final-exam falsifiability source before any model promotion.

canon_candidates.candidate: AI becomes godlike when database omniscience is joined to religious imagination, making automated direction feel inhabited, salvific, demonic, or divine enough to command attention and obedience.
canon_candidates.promotion_note: Candidate only; should be reviewed with the Holy Empire of AI, dollar-AI consciousness-war, and final-exam AI-redundancy sources.

canon_candidates.candidate: Eschatology stores geopolitics as story when long conflict, exile, return, and imperial memory become sacred roles that later actors can remember and reenact.
canon_candidates.promotion_note: Candidate only; likely belongs first as a public Eschatology deepening layer unless recurrence proves it needs a glossary entry.

next_actions.action: Do not append the whole AI-god material to Attention Capture before reviewing the boundary across Attention Capture, Mass Society, Eschatology, and Power As Alchemy.
Compare this lecture with the 2026-05-28 final-exam impact before promoting any predictive-history framework canon language.
After this newest-source intake, return to the Game Theory split/close review around proximity, elite overproduction, and domestic-war pressure unless a newer source appears.
